title: pteris aquilina f. esculenta
intro: Pteris aquilina f. esculenta, commonly known as the bracken fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Pteris genus and is known for its edible rhizome. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pteris aquilina f. esculenta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant also contribute to its use in traditional medicine for its potential to treat various health conditions, including diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and certain types of cancer.
